title: Camps C11 — Registration link
subtitle: Rules v1.015 (one “Registration link” button with its words on every screen; Camps keeps its blue, its phone button gets words) and v1.106 / v1.111 (the shared box components/RegistrationLinkBox.jsx + lib/qr.js). Three changes: (a) phones: the icon-only blue square becomes the blue Registration link button with its words, on its own line under the camp’s name and line, as Color Belt’s buttons go under the title on phones; ⋯ stays beside it. (b) the box becomes the shared one (Camps’ card heading “Both schools · held at Worcester”, one link, no flyer): a failed copy or download now shows its amber note inside the box, in the shared words, until the box closes or the action works. Today it is a bar on the page behind the box — on phones the full-screen box hides it until you go back. (c) the QR file’s name (card at the bottom). PC and tablet buttons don’t change. Amber = what changes.

items.caption: (c) The QR file’s name — question for Jeffrey. A both-schools camp gets “April Vacation Camp QR code.png” either way. A one-school camp: A no school, or B “… - Worcester QR code.png”. B matches the rule v1.106 wrote (“[event] - [school] QR code.png”), its approved M5 one-school Color Belt sample (“November Children Testing - Worcester QR code.png”) and Star (v0.518: “[event] - Worcester QR code.png”). Recommend B.

footer: Words that change: copy failure “Couldn't copy the link. Select the link and copy it by hand.” (Camps) → “… copy it yourself.” (shared COPY_FAILED); download failure “Couldn't make the QR code file. Try again.” → “Couldn't make the QR code picture. Try again.” (shared QR_FAILED; same note place, not shot). Camps passes: title “Registration link”, the camp name, today’s line, one link { url: campLink(code), school: null (both-schools) or the school (option B), heading: “Both schools · held at Worcester” / “Worcester” } (a one-school camp keeps its heading “Worcester”, not the default “Worcester school”); no flyer. With one link the buttons never name a school. Phone button: Color Belt and Star have no ⋯, so ⋯ beside the button is Camps’ own — the same pair as Camps’ PC header. Color Belt hasn’t switched to the shared box yet on any branch; Star has (v0.518). The link shows “localhost:5791” because this is the preview. Drawn: the After box is the real shared box mounted with Camps’ words (a failing copy passed in, as the parts page does); the phone header is the real one re-arranged (button’s words added, its square class removed); the file-name card is drawn, its names worked out by the real qrFileName helpers (Camps’ today and the shared one). Script: mock-c11-link.js.
